name: glb-designer-stage3b
description: Asset Studio Stage 3b — fittings/component library + snap-to-surface placement in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Build a wide flat tabletop box (underside raised off the floor), arm a Tapered leg in the Components panel, and PLACE it on the tabletop underside via the SWOOD face-click (driven through the window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace automation seam with an underside point + downward normal) — it lands as a named 'Tapered leg' Group, oriented plumb, its top flush on the underside plane. Repeat ×4 mirrors it to all four corners → 4 'Tapered leg' group rows in the layers tree. Then add a second box, arm a Bar pull, and place it on that box's upright +Z face — the placed group carries an identity (no) rotation, proving the bar stays HORIZONTAL against the face. Finally Save and assert the persisted UserGltfDef's assetSpec envelope embeds all 5 component groups (4 legs + 1 pull) with the pull's identity orientation — so a placed fitting round-trips as an editable PartGroup. Screenshots the four-legged frame + the handle on the face.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: shape-tabletop
steps.comment: Make box 1 a wide flat tabletop raised to y=0.45 so its underside plane (y≈0.425) is a leg-height off the floor.
steps.eval: (function(){ const set = (label, val) => { const inp = document.querySelector(`.glb-designer input[aria-label="${label}"]`); if (!inp) throw new Error('missing input: ' + label); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, String(val)); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('box size X', 1.2); set('box size Y', 0.05); set('box size Z', 0.8); set('box position Y', 0.45); })()

steps.name: expand-components
steps.comment: Expand the collapsed Components section (progressive-disclosure Disclosure) before interacting.

steps.name: arm-tapered-leg
steps.comment: Arm the Tapered leg fitting — the Components panel then invites a face click.

steps.name: assert-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Tapered leg armed')) throw new Error('Tapered leg did not arm'); if (typeof window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace !== 'function') throw new Error('placement seam window.__glbDesignerPlaceOnFace missing'); })()

steps.name: place-leg-1
steps.comment: SWOOD click on the tabletop UNDERSIDE near the +X/+Z corner: point on the underside plane, normal pointing straight down. The leg hangs down from it, plumb, its top flush on the plane.

steps.name: assert-leg-group-and-inspector
steps.comment: One 'Tapered leg' group row appears and the group is selected (the Repeat ×4 action is available in its Edit-group panel).
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); const legs = names.filter(t => t === 'Tapered leg').length; if (legs !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Tapered leg group row, got ' + legs); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Repeat to all four corners"]')) throw new Error('Repeat ×4 action missing — the placed group should be selected'); })()

steps.name: repeat-x4
steps.comment: One tap mirrors the leg to all four corners about the tabletop bbox centre.

steps.name: assert-four-legs
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); const legs = names.filter(t => t === 'Tapered leg').length; if (legs !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 Tapered leg group rows after Repeat ×4, got ' + legs); })()

steps.name: add-drawer-box
steps.comment: A second box to carry a handle on its upright front face (DOM-click the Add-shape Box button — the toolbar is scrolled out of view after Repeat, so a coordinate click would miss).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Box'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Add-shape Box button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: shape-drawer-box
steps.eval: (function(){ const set = (label, val) => { const inp = document.querySelector(`.glb-designer input[aria-label="${label}"]`); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, String(val)); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set('box size X', 0.6); set('box size Y', 0.6); set('box size Z', 0.05); set('box position X', 1.3); set('box position Y', 0.3); set('box position Z', 0); })()

steps.name: expand-components-2
steps.comment: Expand the collapsed Components section (progressive-disclosure Disclosure) before interacting.

steps.name: assert-pull-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.body.textContent.includes('Bar pull armed')) throw new Error('Bar pull did not arm'); })()

steps.name: place-bar-pull
steps.comment: Click the drawer box's upright +Z front face (normal +Z). The pull sits on the face, bar horizontal — identity rotation.

steps.name: assert-pull-horizontal
steps.comment: The placed Bar pull group is selected; its Edit-group rotation fields read 0/0/0 → identity → the bar's long axis stays world-horizontal against the face.
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); if (names.filter(t => t === 'Bar pull').length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Bar pull group row'); const rot = ['X','Y','Z'].map(a => { const inp = document.querySelector(`.glb-designer input[aria-label="group rotation ${a}"]`); if (!inp) throw new Error('group rotation ' + a + ' field missing (pull group not selected?)'); return Number(inp.value); }); if (!rot.every(v => v === 0)) throw new Error('Bar pull should be placed with identity rotation (horizontal), got ' + rot.join(',')); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage3b Fittings'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-component-groups
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec is the shared asset envelope and embeds all 5 component groups (4 'Tapered leg' + 1 'Bar pull'), with the pull carrying no rotation (identity → horizontal). A placed fitting persists as an editable PartGroup and restores intact.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage3b Fittings' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"kind":"asset"') && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); const s = env.payload; const groups = s.partGroups || []; const legs = groups.filter(g => g.name === 'Tapered leg'); const pulls = groups.filter(g => g.name === 'Bar pull'); return groups.length === 5 && legs.length === 4 && pulls.length === 1 && !pulls[0].rotation; } catch { return false } })())
